title: centranthus calcitrapae subsp. orbiculatus
intro: Centranthus calcitrapae subsp. orbiculatus, commonly known as Mountain Bluet or Jerusalem Bluet, is a plant species belonging to the family Valerianaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including digestive problems and skin conditions, due to its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Centranthus calcitrapae subsp. orbiculatus include soothing irritated skin and mucous membranes, as well as providing relief from digestive discomfort. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
